source_of_truth: ea/FTMO_Bridge_EA.mq5 (pre-patch snapshot described; post-patch v1.01 in repo)

pre_patch_behavior.signal_id: ExtractJsonString(line, "signal_id") — empty falls back to IntegerToString(GetTickCount64())
pre_patch_behavior.symbol: ExtractJsonString("symbol") then StringReplace(_, "") for broker symbol
pre_patch_behavior.side: ExtractJsonString("side") must be BUY or SELL
pre_patch_behavior.units: ExtractJsonInt via ExtractJsonDouble — numeric JSON only
pre_patch_behavior.stop_loss: ExtractJsonDouble — scans first numeric run after ':' ; JSON null yields empty string then StringToDouble → 0
pre_patch_behavior.entry_type: not inspected pre-patch (any line with matching bridge could trade)
pre_patch_behavior.execution_allowed: ExtractJsonBool — if false AND InpPaperOnly, line skipped
pre_patch_behavior.MARKET_build: CTrade.PositionOpen(symbol, orderType, lots, price, sl, tp) with price = ASK/BID — passes sl/tp including 0 from null coerced to double

post_patch_v1_01_mapping.nullable_numbers: ExtractJsonNumberKind distinguishes ABSENT, NULL, VALUE for stop_loss, take_profit, units
post_patch_v1_01_mapping.MARKET_only: entry_type must equal MARKET or SIGNAL_SKIP
post_patch_v1_01_mapping.market_execution: CTrade.Buy / CTrade.Sell with price=0; slSend/tpSend only non-zero when JSON had numeric > 0
post_patch_v1_01_mapping.request_log: REQUEST_SUMMARY line before send with sl_set/tp_set flags and values
